rule: DESIGN §W7 step 7 (stats O4), implemented with the reviewed shortlist harness: both candidates are gated vs G* (§8, CI lower bound > 0, L_prob, all genes, U, no stratum); among eligible candidates the paired one-SE rule (§9) picks the first in spec order, simplest first: W7:B6 (= idea W7-01, H-b, the B6 ablation, the runner-up) before W7:W7-05 (promoted idea).
